alignment_and_reads.extra_current_reads_reason: Current values are loaded once through four m128 widening reads and again through two m256 delta/support reads per hardware iteration. This is load byte traffic, not extra addresses outside the array.
alignment_and_reads.memory_loads: vmovdqu m256 and vpmovzxdq m128; accept ordinary u32 alignment, no new32-byte-alignment requirement

error_order.equivalence: Nonnegative current frequencies have a prefix above the cap iff the complete sum is above the cap. Error priority stays cap before negative conversion.
error_order.negative_conversion: 0x10bc4d8 shr32 detects negative>UINT32_MAX after total cap validation
error_order.performance_claim: None: early vs late checks explain differing work paths without ranking throughput from disassembly.
error_order.scalar: Checked u64 prefix sum then InvalidFrequencyTotal in the loop; generic scalar overflow checks remain.
error_order.vector: Scan complete arrays and horizontally reduce u64 total, then check InvalidFrequencyTotal at0x10bc4a9; only after that reduce/check negative mass conversion to u32.

isa.scalar_support_instruction: POPCNT not required in scalar query; setcc/64bitadds count support. Vector query uses vmovmskps+POPCNT.

public_encoder.scope: One actual inlined call site; no assertion that every caller or other target is identical.

scalar_path.current_load: 0x10bc638 mov m32 into r12d zero-extends to64-bit r12
scalar_path.negative_subtract: u32 prior-now only after unsigned prior>now check, then add64-bit r13 to rcx

widening.overflow_proof: Every total/negative u64 lane receives32u32 values; horizontal reduction of eight lanes stays below2^40. No u32 reduction wrap and no u64 overflow is possible for the complete fixed arrays.
total_path: 0x10bc488..0x10bc49f horizontal reduction uses vpaddq YMM/XMM then vmovq
